expectations.text: The agent captured the failed request in the browser flow (the POST /api/subscribe returning 422 for an address with +) rather than only reading the code

expectations.text: QA-REPORT.md names the cause: public/app.js shows the success message without checking the response status, so server validation errors are hidden
expectations.evidence: Root cause section: '`public/app.js` never checks the HTTP status of `POST /api/subscribe`... A `422` (or `500`) resolves normally, so the page shows the success message and clears the form.'

expectations.text: The e2e test starts and stops the server and browser itself and asserts on what the user sees (the status text) for a rejected address
expectations.evidence: before() spawns server.js with PORT '0' and calls chromium.launch(), after() calls browser?.close() and server?.kill(), and each rejected-address test runs assert.doesNotMatch(r.message, SUCCESS, ...) on the #status textContent.
